Game Overview

At its heart, Jumping Bat is a casual game about leap into action with a bat that needs your help to soar. Tap the screen to propel your feathery friend upwards, navigating through challenging obstacles. Despite its simplicity, this game delivers a thrilling test of timing and skill. Will you master the jump?
